episodes.synopsis: While carrying out his hellish bureaucratic duties, Hozuki encounters a legendary hero. Hozuki and King Enma dream of taking a trip to Australia.
episodes.title: Making or Breaking Hell / The Discovery of Hell's Mysteries

episodes.synopsis: Despite being tasked with cleaning the rivers of hell, low-ranking demon Nasubi becomes distracted by a song. King Enma welcomes a guest from Europe.
episodes.title: Demons and Underwear and Crabs / The State of Hell, and This and That

episodes.synopsis: Ignoring King Enma’s advice, Momotaro's companions risk visiting Hozuki on his day off. King Enma reveals why Hozuki and Hakutaku are always at odds.
episodes.title: Hakutakuk / How Their Discord Came to Be

episodes.synopsis: Accompanied by Shiro, Hozuki departs for the Karasu-Tengu police station. Hozuki teaches the lazy new demon recruits about the art of torture.
episodes.title: Pretty Boys Need Love Too / Kajika Hell

episodes.synopsis: Hozuki and Shiro go on a quest for an essential stew ingredient. The 100th annual Hell’s Minions Sports Day commences with an unconventional bang.
episodes.title: The Instrumental Duo of the Mighty Rivals / Mental Sports Day

episodes.synopsis: Looking for his next scoop, gossip magazine reporter Koban begs Hozuki for an interview. Beelzebub from European hell visits the Japanese underworld.
episodes.title: Hell Idol: Peach Maki / The Right Arm Blues

episodes.synopsis: Hozuki, Karauri and Nasubi visit an area of hell reserved for a certain kind of sinner. King Enma employs the help of Hozuki to receive acupuncture.
episodes.title: Man and Woman and Mortal Hell / Hell-Style Acupuncture and Moxibustion Techniques and How to Use the Johari Mirror

episodes.synopsis: Koban turns his attention to Peach Maki and Hozuki in crafting his latest gossip article. Hozuki asks Nasubi to create a new mural fit for hell.
episodes.title: The Vulgar Battle / The 36 Views of Hell

episodes.synopsis: Momotaro makes an offhand comment that deals a blow to Hakutaku’s ego. Hozuki helps an eight-headed snake demon deal with a group of drunken sinners.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Example of Ruin Through Wine and Women / Awash With Drunks

episodes.synopsis: King Enma holds a dinner for hell's nine other noble judges. Concerned about his weight, King Enma hits the gym with hell’s strictest trainer: Hozuki.
episodes.title: Dinner of the Ten Kings of the Afterlife / Diets are Hell

episodes.synopsis: After hearing the tale of the “Inch-High Samurai,” Shiro wonders what became of its titular hero. A pint-sized spirit comes to Hozuki with a problem.
episodes.title: The Samurai Who Was Inch-High / Marsh Sisters on the Mountain

episodes.synopsis: Western she-devil Lady Lilith visits the Japanese underworld on a shopping trip. Hakutaku recalls the time he drunkenly fell into the mortal world.
episodes.title: Lady Lillith and her Husband / Why Monsters are so Widely-Spread Throughout the Mundane World of China

episodes.synopsis: Shiro and his pals Rurio and Kakisuke experience their first-ever festival in hell. King Enma and Hozuki kill time until their next batch of sinners.
episodes.title: Hell's Bon Festival of Lights / Idle Chat with the Great King Enma
